activation_policy: Bindings execute only when the canonical record, evidence-bearing profile, and promoted magnitude fields agree.

bindings.name: abyssal scimitar
assumptions: No hit, critical, armor, resistance, or timing constants are activated by this binding.
bindings.safe_fallback: Reject resolution when the canonical record, binding, or exact profile is unavailable.
bindings.runtime_impact: Allows the promoted weapon damage range to enter the shared deterministic resolution pipeline.
bindings.character_save_impact: Only the owning mutation sink may persist resulting HP/resource changes.
bindings.world_state_impact: No mutation occurs until the atomic executor commits through an owning sink.

bindings.name: a cloud of poison gas
assumptions: Attack type 4 and resist type 0 remain opaque enum values; the binding preserves them without assigning semantic names.
bindings.safe_fallback: Reject activation until a matching evidence-bearing profile explicitly preserves unresolved enum identity.
bindings.runtime_impact: Makes canonical spell identity and extracted magnitude range bindable without claiming resistance or saving-throw formulas.
bindings.character_save_impact: None until committed by an owning spell-effect or resource sink.
bindings.world_state_impact: None until committed by an owning event sink.
